answer: A simple idea is to pot up any houseplants in larger decorative pots; even herbs like thyme that just need occasional watering make great projects. You can also pile up newspapers or cardboard in trash bags, seal them, and set them outside to deter slugs. Because very little water is used, a rifle-style hose is actually more efficient than a sprinkler. Just keep checking on things once or twice a day to be sure you are not overwatering.
